## Changes

- The reader remembers the page you stopped at. Unfinished chapters show their page (for example 5 / 24) in the chapter list and reopen at that page; a chapter gets its check once you reach the last page.
- Auto-scroll in the vertical reader: tap play in the top bar, and set the speed in **Pengaturan baca**. Touch the screen to pause it.
- Shared series now include a link (bacakomik.kurodev.org/series/…) that opens the series in the app, or a download page when the app is not installed.
- Long-press a series title to copy it.
- The bookmark update badge now counts the chapters you have not read, not the chapters after the last one you opened.
